How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 20-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DGFT Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 20th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Economics, MBA, B.Tech/B.E. (Mechanical/Chemical/IT/CS), MCA, M.Com, or LL.M from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Young Professional post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the DGFT Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on merit.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Young Professional post in the Director General of Foreign Trade.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Young Professional position is a contract-based job.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the DGFT office located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the DGFT office located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600006.
